BiblicalUsage: Rûwm is the word for elevation or (figuratively) elation. It stands in Isaiah 2:11, "The lofty looks of man shall be humbled…", and in Jeremiah 48:29, "…the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud)…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rûwm is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
